Hymn 201: Joy to the World
Time Signature: 2/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: George F. Handel

Category: Christmas

This is hymn number 201 titled "Joy to the World" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 2/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by George F. Handel and the lyrics were written by Isaac Watts.
